dialogues.speaker: Sleepy
dialogues.text: While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail!

dialogues.speaker: Sleepy
dialogues.text: Hold on a second, I don't know you... Why would you come up and start making conversation with me? It's bad manners!

dialogues.speaker: Sleepy
dialogues.text: Can't you see I'm at my post? If you want to make conversation, you should tell me first!

dialogues.speaker: Sleepy
dialogues.text: Doesn't telling you count as part of the conversation?

dialogues.speaker: Sleepy
dialogues.text: If that were the case, you should at least know to give me a heads up before telling me you want to make conversation... Honestly...

dialogues.speaker: Sleepy
dialogues.text: Apology accepted! I appreciate it! Have a wonderful day!
